item.title: Square White Background Sneaker

turns.text: Create one marketplace product photo of a white leather sneaker. Square image, plain white background, just the shoe.

item.tests: Delivers a text-generated marketplace image with the requested square framing and clean white background.

answer_sheet.Background and composition: Plain white background, just the shoe.

must_haves: Exactly one white leather sneaker is shown.
The background is plain white, with no scenery or props.
The entire shoe is visible with space around it.
No promotional text, badges or graphic borders appear.

I couldn't make the photo. Magic Hour turned down the request because your account doesn't have enough credits, so no image was created and no credits were charged.

I'd already used the cheapest image model on the free plan (about 5 credits for one 640px image), so a different setting won't get around this.

**To continue:** add credits or upgrade your plan in your Magic Hour account, then tell me and I'll run it again. Here's the request I'd send:
- **Image:** one white leather sneaker on its own, angled slightly to the side, in the center of the frame
- **Background:** plain white, with even studio lighting and a soft shadow under the shoe
- **Format:** square, 640px, with no text, logos or other objects
